decisive_evidence.zero_shot: No preregistered representation and model passed all predictive dataset-level gates.
decisive_evidence.few_shot: No disjoint-cell calibration budget and method passed all baseline, zero-shot-improvement, and multi-dataset gates.
decisive_evidence.applicability: The source-calibrated guard accepted every row, produced many false accepts, and failed uncertainty gates on every dataset.
decisive_evidence.cell_level: Strong same-dataset results on Leonardi and mostly on SiCWell do not overturn failed dataset transfer; Oxford also failed within-dataset.

allowed_followup: Treat V5 and V6 as negative evidence about a universal zero-shot or tiny-calibration model under the tested inputs.
If research continues, formulate a new chemistry-specific or protocol-specific question with a new contract; do not call it V7 automatically.
Use the dataset-qualification and abstention failure analysis as a separate research contribution if useful.
prohibited_followup: Do not freeze or externally validate a V6 candidate.
Do not search for a fresh V6 holdout because no V6 candidate passed development gates.
Do not retune thresholds or representations and relabel this bounded study as the same decision.
Do not soften the verdict using strong same-dataset cell folds.
claim_boundary: This is a negative bounded development result on four previously inspected or scored datasets. It does not prove every narrower chemistry-specific or protocol-specific model is impossible.
